name: foreign-trade-email-assistant
description: Optional compatibility plugin for standalone complete-thread foreign-trade email replies when the unified customer-operations skill is not used.

interface.longDescription: A salesperson-controlled assistant for analyzing complete customer email threads, preparing reply recommendations and bilingual drafts, revising from natural-language feedback, and handling explicit quality, contract, or payment issues without taking over business judgment or sending authority.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this complete customer email thread and prepare a bilingual reply draft.
Revise this foreign-trade reply using my feedback and the full thread context.
Prepare a controlled review package for this quality, contract, or payment issue.
